decisions.reason: The existing message-53 MODIFY already captures the approved solenoid actuation and press-to-open, release-to-stop control behavior; no additional state change is required.
The approved dispensing path does not change the existing requirement that the bowl seal prevent leakage into the base.

The existing message-53 MODIFY already records the approved rendered appearance, stainless-steel material, and custom fabrication; the dispensing-path details belong to the separate pour and control requirements.
The statement that the spout faces the baristas confirms the already-current orientation and does not modify it.
Preventing retained matcha in the spout or tubing does not remove or revise the existing requirement that the liquid path support effective cleaning between uses.
The selected dispensing path does not change the requirement that the bottom bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
Preserving frothiness during dispensing does not modify the independently defined mixing-output and foam-consistency requirements.
The approved electrically actuated solenoid and button control necessarily become part of the active basic wiring plan.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Go ahead with that approach, and please match the rendering as closely as possible; I really like both its appearance and functionality. I do want one change from the rendering: move the plate labeled "Elena's Chai Whisk" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will face the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle, so the "Elena's Chai Whisk" plate needs to face the customer.
